manifest.name: checkbox
manifest.title: Checkbox
manifest.description: A checkbox on Base UI's Checkbox, ticked, unticked or mixed, in three sizes, with CheckboxGroup for several checkboxes sharing one value and a parent "select all".
manifest.usage: Use Checkbox for a yes/no choice that is applied when the form is submitted ("Include column headers"), and CheckboxGroup for picking any number of options from a short list. Wrap each checkbox and its text in a FieldLabel inside a Field; in a group, put a FieldLegend first and each option in a FieldItem. With TanStack Form wire checked, onCheckedChange and onBlur (or the group's value and onValueChange) to the field. For a setting that takes effect at once use Switch; for one choice out of several, RadioGroup; for a long list, a MultiSelect.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called when the user ticks or unticks it.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: The mixed state: a dash, aria-checked="mixed".

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the checkbox in a CheckboxGroup's value.

props.name: parent
props.description: In a CheckboxGroup with allValues: ticks or clears all of them, and is mixed while some are ticked.

props.name: size
props.description: Box size from size.icon.sm, md or lg.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name of the hidden input; a Field's name wins.

props.name: required
props.description: Must be ticked before the form submits.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The box, role="checkbox"; data-slot="checkbox", data-size, data-checked, data-indeterminate. A hidden <input type="checkbox"> follows it.

slots.name: indicator
slots.description: The check or dash, rendered while ticked or mixed.

parts.name: CheckboxGroup
parts.description: Checkboxes sharing one string[] value, a column with gap space.stack.sm; a fieldset named by its FieldLegend.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the box: color.interactive.hover, or the accent solid's hover colour when ticked.

states.name: checked
states.description: Ticked: the accent solid with a check in color.accent.fg.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: Mixed: the accent solid with a dash, aria-checked="mixed".

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field: a color.status.danger.border border.

accessibility: Renders a <span role="checkbox"> with aria-checked (true, false or mixed) and a hidden native input for forms; Tab reaches it and Space toggles it.
Label it by wrapping it in a FieldLabel with its text; the text then toggles it too and enlarges the target beyond the 14 to 20 px box (WCAG 2.2 target size).
A group is a fieldset named by its FieldLegend; a FieldDescription inside a FieldItem describes that option only.
Ticked and mixed are shown by a check or a dash as well as the accent fill; the unticked border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface).
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).
